content.short: Plasma Finance is a cross-chain DeFi aggregator providing a unified dashboard for asset and yield management.
content.description: Plasma Finance is a comprehensive decentralized finance dashboard and aggregator designed to simplify the multi-chain experience for all participants. The platform provides a professional-grade interface to manage portfolios, access deep liquidity across various networks, and execute complex yield strategies within a single environment. Plasma Finance serves as a vital bridge between traditional banking and decentralized technology, featuring integrated fiat on/off ramps. Operating on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon, the protocol ensures maximum security and transparency for users.
content.meta: Plasma Finance offers a multi-chain DeFi aggregator and portfolio dashboard. Discover Plasma Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
